description: Send dates and times typed in the browser's time zone, judged against the campaign dates (#1787): inside is whether ScheduleSet admits the date (no outside_campaign error at it). window is [start, end, campaign time zone], where the page may be proposing new dates or a new zone; browser is the browser's zone; date and time are what is typed there. saved is a saved reminder the row edits ({date, time} campaign-local in its saved zone): a row posted with the date and time the page showed for it keeps the saved date. tests/stewardship/test_schedule_window_rule.py runs every case through the server's formset; tests/stewardship/browser/test_schedule_window.py runs it through the page script's ParishSendWindow.judge in every engine. No case falls in an hour the campaign's clocks repeat (refused at the time instead).

cases.why: 10 PM on October 31 in Los Angeles is 1 AM on November 1 in New York.
8:59 PM in Los Angeles is 11:59 PM, still October 31, in New York.
9 PM in Los Angeles is midnight starting November 1 in New York.
A Los Angeles date before the window that is its first moment in New York.
One minute earlier is still September 30 in New York.
Auckland (UTC+13) on October 1 at 4:59 PM is September 30 in New York.
Auckland on October 1 at 5 PM is midnight October 1 in New York.
An Auckland date after the window that is still October 31 in New York.
One minute later is November 1 in New York.
The browser in the campaign's zone: the first moment.
The browser in the campaign's zone: just before.
The browser in the campaign's zone: the last minute.
The browser in the campaign's zone: just after.
Kolkata's half-hour offset: 9:29 AM is September 30 in New York.
Kolkata at 9:30 AM is midnight October 1 in New York.
Pago Pago (UTC-11) and Kiritimati (UTC+14) are a day and an hour apart: September 30 in the browser is October 1 for the campaign.
September 29 in Pago Pago is still September 30 at Kiritimati.
October 31 in Pago Pago is November 1 at Kiritimati.
Santiago skips midnight on its first day (September 6, 2054, 12:00 AM becomes 1:00 AM): midnight in New York is that day's first moment.
A minute before is 11:59 PM on September 5 in Santiago.
Beirut skips midnight on March 29, 2054: 10 PM in London (still GMT) is its first moment.
A minute before is 11:59 PM on March 28 in Beirut.
2:30 AM is skipped in New York on March 8, 2054 and reads forward as 3:00 AM EDT, midnight March 8 in Phoenix: after the window.
1:59 AM, before New York's gap, is 11:59 PM March 7 in Phoenix.
1:30 AM happens twice in New York on November 1, 2054; the first (EDT) is 11:30 PM October 31 in Regina, inside the window.
A saved 12:30 AM October 1 New York reminder shown as 9:30 PM September 30 in Los Angeles and posted as shown keeps its saved date in a proposed Chicago zone.
The same row with its time changed converts into Chicago: 11:31 PM September 30.
A proposed end of October 20 leaves a saved October 24 reminder, posted as shown, outside.
A proposed start of October 5 leaves a saved October 1 reminder, posted as shown, outside.
A saved October 10 reminder shown on October 11 in Auckland and posted as shown is inside.
The same saved reminder moved to November 2 in Auckland is November 1 in New York.
A legacy saved time with seconds (11:59:30 PM October 31, New York) posted as shown, with its seconds, keeps its saved date in a proposed London zone.
The same row retyped without its seconds is a change, read into London: 3:59 AM November 1.
